purpose: Map every SGFX-relevant SWA UI/UX class to its retail-fidelity source: api/ struct headers (validated by SWA_ASSERT_OFFSETOF) and ppc_recomp.*.cpp Update bodies (the static-decompile oracle for behaviors not exposed via api/ headers). The recompiled UnleashedRecomp.exe doesn't expose the sub_XXXX PPC symbols Ghidra needs (XenonRecomp translates them into x64 functions with new addresses), so the auto-translated source files in local_build_env/ur103clean/UnleashedRecompLib/ppc/ppc_recomp.*.cpp are the static-decompile oracle. This map lets future retroactive ports target the right body directly.
discovery_method: Read api/SWA/**/*.h for retail field offsets validated by SWA_ASSERT_OFFSETOF. Searched local_build_env/ur103clean/UnleashedRecompLib/ppc/ppc_recomp.*.cpp for PPC_FUNC_IMPL(__imp__sub_XXXXXXXX) declarations.
ghidra_status: Ghidra cannot run from the agent CLI environment. Even if it could, analyzeHeadless on the recompiled x64 binary returns UNRESOLVED for every PPC sub_ symbol because XenonRecomp translates PPC bodies into x64 functions with new addresses. To get Ghidra-side PPC decompiles a future user-driven phase would import the original Xbox 360 default.xex into a fresh Ghidra project. ppc_recomp.*.cpp is the equivalent static decompile and is preferred.
